'''Abram Zavict''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] independent trader who was friends with the [[Balinaka]] [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptor]] [[Vornest Dep-thesel Digarsarg]]. When Digarsarg created his sculpture, "[[Crystal of the Stars]]," and became aware of its beautiful, hypnotic light, Zavict chanced across the scene and was similarly enraptured. Zavict decided to sell them to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], founding [[Galactic Crystal Creations]], a company that would sell the resulting [[Garnib crystal]]s on other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].
